status: complete written packets; execution readiness blocked at G0

tasks.title: Establish pinned local runtime, shared wire fixtures and command gate
steps: Pin Node24/PG18 application/test container baseline and exact compatible dependency versions/lockfile. Use only the fixed host-native/Compose binding profiles: host loopback and container-internal listener with127.0.0.1-only published port. No global installs, remote DB, paid API or framework replacement.
Create ESM TypeScript build and exact C-FOUNDATION scripts; missing test families must not silently pass. Minimal API/worker/UI entries only.
Freeze wire types and mock API/job shapes from contract examples; hashes must match exact source bytes. Mock results are synthetic fixtures, not application acceptance.

Implement local configuration/test-database guards and record actual baseline, Docker daemon result, script definitions and command-family readiness in repo_context. G0 fails on missing compatibility/evidence.
tests: Unit config: reject remote DB/public host publication and unsafe test target; accept fixed Compose/loopback config without logging credentials.
Build/typecheck under Node24; inspect exact scripts and run available foundation checks; absent future suites remain explicitly blocked.
Contract fixtures: wire envelopes, UUID/money-string/null shapes agree with C-API.
criteria: Node24 minimal app/web build with pinned lockfile is observed, not inferred from host Node25.
Declared commands exist and each execution/readiness outcome is recorded truthfully.
Shared typed/mock handoffs permit consumers to start without provider internals.
No financial implementation, public deployment or data reset is included.
tasks.rollback: Revert only foundation-owned files; preserve docs and unrelated runtime state. Never reset a DB volume to hide failure.

tasks.title: Normalize exact source profiles and freeze scenario fixtures
steps: Implement exact manifest/header/encoding/date/identity/byte/row/field rules in C-SOURCE. No heuristic column mapping.
Parse decimal amounts to signed integer-cent strings using BigInt arithmetic, preserving raw values and file/record lineage.
Freeze valid/invalid S1-S8 fixtures including corrected whole bundle, header-only scope, duplicate IDs, unknown category, dispute identity limits and boundary sizes.
tests: 100.00->10000, -30.00->-3000, supplied9680 net and6680 payout subtotal; reject exponent/excess precision/bound/currency.
Table-driven BOM/multiline/quoting/duplicate header/UTF8/NUL/empty/date/ID/limit cases, with exact-bound and one-over assertions.
Equal amounts with distinct external IDs survive; header-only is zero observed activity, not real completeness.
criteria: Documented example normalizes with exact amounts and stable raw row refs.
Every invalid source yields bounded named diagnostic and no runnable partial bundle.
Corrected books contains supplied -3000 and no invented fee/treatment.
Consumer fixture/schema conformance is frozen without private parser knowledge.
tasks.rollback: Version profile and update all consumers/fixtures for changes; never reinterpret accepted old source bytes silently.

tasks.title: Create revision-owned schema, role grants and migration boundary
steps: Implement C-DB tables/constraints/indexes/RESTRICT history and API/worker/migration role grants exactly. No ORM or destructive automatic reset.
Provide parameterized node-postgres transaction helper and coordinated schema/queue installation before normal app startup.
Provide disposable equivra_test_<hex> DB fixtures with safety guard; seed frozen source/run/evidence; run role and rollback checks.
tests: Real PG migration apply/recheck, unique/FK/check failures and complete rollback.
Runtime roles cannot UPDATE/DELETE immutable facts; worker cannot INSERT review/snapshot or change review aggregate.
Test DB helper refuses primary/remote targets; source/run relations cannot cross owning revision.
criteria: Versioned schema/grants match C-DB and local runtime can connect with the intended roles.
Constraints reject invalid identity/ownership and immutable-history mutation.
Isolated DB fixture and transaction handoff usable by consumers.
Actual migration/integration evidence recorded; no missing Docker/DB command marked pass.
tasks.rollback: Stop API/worker; preserve paired DB+source archive; restore compatible schema/application pair instead of deleting history.

tasks.title: Enforce current-start local access and browser boundary
steps: Generate per-start code with crypto and bounded constant-time Bearer comparison. Intentional terminal display only, structured logs redacted.
Install protected /api/v1/download guard globally; shell/minimal health reveal no app data.
Enforce loopback/exact Host/mutating Origin/cross-site checks and declared bounded failed-code throttle. Use normal Fastify plugin/config wiring, no test bypass.
tests: Current code allowed; missing/wrong/previous-start401; hostile Host/Origin/null/cross-site403 even with code.
Content/size checks reject before handler; failed-code threshold429.
Captured JSON/errors/structured logs/URLs do not contain code; browser memory/reload assertions at INT-03.
criteria: All data/actions/downloads guarded before domain work.
Restart revokes old access, health/static cannot disclose it.
Safe error mapping and no writes on denied request.
tasks.rollback: Stop local API to revoke code; keep data intact; never fallback to an unguarded mode.

tasks.title: Accept immutable whole bundles and preview validated sources
steps: Implement exact multipart/manifest and GET bundle preview(max25 rows/source). All three kinds required.
Stage/hash/validate bounded input into generated server paths; durable immutable bytes precede accepting DB transaction.
Atomically insert complete revision/files/rows/run and enqueue via same-client C-JOBS adapter. Exact content replay returns existing identity; changed bytes/manifest new revision.
Cleanup only positively unreferenced abandoned staging; never delete accepted sources after a lost/failed response.
tests: Sample202 and exact replay200 stable bundle/run; corrected complete bundle preserves old facts.
Disk-before-commit and DB-after-file-finalization failures leave no acknowledged dangling revision; cleanup protects referenced bytes.
Concurrent replay both orders one identity/job; missing/malformed/excess source rejects rather than truncates.
criteria: Every accepted bundle pins exactly three immutable sources and durable run/job.
Preview hashes/counts/raw fields agree with original bytes.
Replays do not duplicate economic results; corrections never overwrite old revision.
tasks.rollback: Stop/disable endpoint; retain all referenced source revisions; only verified orphan staging may be removed.

tasks.title: Investigate supported and unresolved financial evidence deterministically
steps: Implement seven frozen C-DOMAIN rules using bounded indexed maps and exact integers, no I/O or model.
Stable case keys/order and references; amount alone never identity. Keep missing/ambiguous/unsupported separate from computation errors.
Preserve scope/date/refund/dispute limits and unlinked observations; no invented fees, wins, losses or accounting advice.
tests: S1 subtotal6680/missing book refund/corrected delta0; missing observed/delta is null, not zero.
S2 exact same dispute identity only, principal and supplied fees distinct; S3 cross-period evidence; S4 reversed source order remains ambiguous.
Unknown categories and extra/unlinked rows explicit; equal amounts/different IDs preserved; all facts resolve to source or exact calculation.
criteria: All normalized scenario facts match expected outcomes with evidence refs.
Same input/rule yields deterministic financial facts and case keys.
No uncertainty becomes supported because of amount equality or reviewer disposition.
Worker/report consumers implement from published shape/fixture only.
tasks.rollback: Changed rules need new rule/run version and consumer fixtures; never mutate historical output.

tasks.title: Execute transactional jobs and eligible retries with recovery proof
steps: Implement pinned pg-boss transaction adapter/options and worker using its supplied transaction for every result write/completion. No direct queue-table update.
Guard current run/job identity and unique case publication; source is pinned revision. Queue state plus application outcome drives API status.
Implement eligible failed-run retry route with expected_job_id, same run/bundle/rules, fresh job and idempotency result in one transaction.
Persist sanitized terminal failure before queue cleanup; prove pending/failed visibility cannot vanish. Stop for architect if pinned API cannot enforce contract.
tests: Real PG enqueue rollback, crash before/after publication, stale/lost claim in both orders and old revision completion after correction.
Finite transient retries/exhaustion visible; invalid/integrity/active/completed run not manually retried.
Exact retry replay returns original; stale job/key body409; no duplicate result.
criteria: No acknowledged run without durable queue job.
Crash/retry yields exactly one owning committed result/case set.
Stale worker cannot overwrite different revision/current job.
Durable queued/running/retrying/failed/completed and eligible retry proven on real PG.
tasks.rollback: Stop worker, preserve source/results/snapshots; retry only eligible owned failure via declared route/library; restore compatible archive for invariant violation.

tasks.title: Save auditable review decisions with expected versions
steps: Implement bounded case/evidence reads and exact decision endpoint; validate references within owning run.
Replay lookup before stale checks; lock run first, compare case version, append decision and increment run aggregate/audit/result atomically.
Save changes review only, never source facts, support status or implicit report freeze.
tests: Valid/invalid note/disposition; missing/cross-revision references; exact lost-response replay and mismatched-key409.
Two equal-version writers both orders yield one successor and one conflict; aggregate and audit correct.
Read latest decision or null/version0; no raw note/code in operational logs.
criteria: No stale overwrite and accurate returned case/aggregate versions.
Reviewer decision never changes financial facts or existing snapshot.
C-REVIEW handoff gives report consumer all version/error semantics.
tasks.rollback: Revert handler with app stopped; preserve append-only decisions/audit and all source evidence.

tasks.title: Freeze complete immutable snapshots and export inert reports
steps: Freeze expected aggregate under same run lock as review; canonical sorted payload/hash includes all published cases and current selected decisions/coverage.
Render snapshot payload only, never latest joins; safe fixed filename/content types and HTML/CSV encoding.
Use snapshot.json only as wire illustration, not full scenario expected case inventory; actual snapshot must include every run case.
tests: Save-before-freeze old version409; freeze-before-save immutable old report plus new draft.
Corrected whole bundle, later reviews and repeat rendering preserve old facts/evidence; failed render keeps snapshot.
Actual download/DOM markup, quotes/newlines and whitespace formula prefixes inert; typed numeric money deliberately formatted.
criteria: Save alone never freezes; freeze atomic and stale-safe.
All published cases and unresolved labels included, no illustrative subset.
Repeated/restore rendering has same financial facts/source refs/decisions.
Unsafe text cannot execute; source raw values retained separately.
tasks.rollback: Preserve snapshots; renderer/profile version change needs compatibility proof; restore paired archive if invariants fail.

tasks.title: Build the complete accessible local React investigation journey
steps: Access, three-source upload/preview, durable status/cases, evidence/review and freeze/export views; native React/fetch, no generic KPI feature.
Code in memory only; refresh/new tab entry;401 clears access.409 preserves draft and asks deliberate reload instead of auto-resubmission.
Explicit loading/empty/error/success/partial states, semantic labels/tables/focus/status, readable long refs and stacked narrow-screen panels.
Start from frozen mock fixtures after G0; runtime merge waits INT-02 conformance, not mock-only success.
tests: Node-driven Playwright full real API/worker/PG import->refund evidence->review->freeze->download.
Invalid/current/previous access and no persistent secret/URL; source errors, queued refresh, stale saves/freezes, eligible retry, zero-case coverage.
Keyboard/focus/narrow-screen amounts/references usable and source strings inert in actual DOM/download.
criteria: Critical journey passes real providers and frozen wire protocol.
All declared states explicit/actionable; uncertainty and review disposition remain separate.
No token in storage/URL/log; conflicts keep draft.
Frozen output shows correct evidence and remaining unknowns.
tasks.rollback: Revert UI only against compatible API; preserve sources/reviews/snapshots, no server workaround hidden in frontend.

tasks.title: Assemble providers and prove API/component conformance
steps: Serially mount actual providers after their owners; preserve C-API shape and access guard order.
Run INT-01 data/jobs and INT-02 API/review/report scenarios against real PG and exact source fixtures.
Propagate correlation and validate redaction/ownership across actual HTTP/job boundaries; provider owner fixes contract mismatch, not consumer reinterpretation.
tests: All method/body/query/status/error/envelope/money-string/null response conformance.
Accepted upload+job+publication then review/freeze both completion orders; cross-revision IDs rejected.
Invalid/old access, Host/Origin and source faults cannot reach mutation/complete success; logs sanitized.
criteria: INT-01 and INT-02 pass real providers, not mocks alone.
Consumer fixtures agree with runtime wire/error shape.
No missing source/version/access/report boundary or duplicate publication.
tasks.rollback: Stop API/worker; preserve DB/files and revert compatible assembly; never reset to manufacture green integration.

tasks.title: Verify clean setup, restore, input envelope and local release evidence
steps: Document exact observed setup/migrate/start/access/demo/stop/restore; commands cannot be advertised passing from their specification alone.
Restore paired DB+raw source archive into disposable target; reproduce prior frozen workpaper after corrections/reviews.
Exercise10000-row and10MiB profile boundaries and one-over; record actual hardware/dataset/time/memory with no invented SLA.
CI uses pinned Node24 and disposable local PG/synthetic fixtures; invokes behavior-owned suites. Complete INT-03 and RELEASE-GATE without hosting, publication or real-data steps.
tests: Integration: paired restore reproduces frozen facts/refs; mismatched archive/integrity rejected.
Integration: each accepted/exceeded input bound yields honest accepted/rejected result, no truncation or partial run.
Clean environment: browser journey/repeat/interruption/old-code denial and no raw source/code in diagnostics; all mandatory check outcomes recorded.
criteria: INT-03 and every release check have actual evidence.
Runbook restores without deleting history; recovery limitations measured/stated.
Build/typecheck/unit/integration/e2e/CI outcomes explicit; missing/failed checks block release.
README/demo plainly synthetic, no production/revenue/savings/universal-format claims.
tasks.rollback: Retain prior compatible version/archive, stop on invariant/security failure, do not publish or delete data to hide it.

invariants.INV-01: Only the current-start code may access application data/actions; loopback/Host/Origin enforced; worker cannot insert reviewer decisions/snapshots.
invariants.INV-02: All monetary arithmetic uses exact integer cents, currency usd, source values preserved; gross-fee=net verified; no guessed fees.
invariants.INV-03: An accepted input pins a complete three-file immutable revision and durable run/job; no acknowledged partial or dangling bundle.
invariants.INV-04: Source event identities remain distinct; duplicate submission/recovery creates one owning financial result; corrections and stale jobs cannot overwrite other revisions.
invariants.INV-05: Review and freeze serialize against the same owning run; expected versions reject stale changes; exact-request replay returns the original committed result.
invariants.INV-06: Frozen snapshot captures all cases/facts/evidence/decisions; renderer uses that payload only; later corrections/reviews never change old facts.
invariants.INV-07: Incomplete/ambiguous/unsupported evidence remains explicit; a reviewer disposition or balanced supplied subtotal cannot prove complete real books.
invariants.INV-08: Enforce10000 data rows/10MiB per source and bounded parsing/errors; source text inert; secrets/raw rows absent from logs.
invariants.INV-09: Only observed command/test/benchmark/recovery outcomes count as evidence; synthetic local scope never implies hosted/real-data acceptance.
